title: Classic Beef Stew
description: A hearty and comforting beef stew made with tender beef and vegetables in a rich broth.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the broth, thyme, and bay leaf to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh thyme if desired.
